summary: The JSON pretty-print feature is implemented but unverified: I could not run tests, the formatter, or any repository code, so all checks were by reading. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; new rich/json.py with the JSON renderable and a __main__ CLI; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, new reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree entry); CHANGELOG Unreleased Added entry; new tests test_print_json (tests/test_console.py) and test_rich_print_json (tests/test_rich_print.py). The expected ANSI output in test_print_json was derived by reading Style rendering code, not by running it. Open choices: the CLI block imports Console inside the __main__ guard, and overflow=None is used because Text does not accept "none". Nothing was committed.
